dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hey! Ready to do some quality assurance on our test questions?

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Wonderful. Just don't forget to pace yourself.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Yep. All you gotta do is defeat a certain number within the time limit. But, hey... leave some for the trainees, okay?

choices.text: I'm not in a rush. Up for a chat?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Sure! Feels like it's been ages since we last saw each other.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: If we'd known you were coming, we would've prepared a whole welcome feast! All new recipes and everything!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All new?

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: It's a funny story, actually. The last time I was in Fontaine, I brought a few cook books and some spices back with me.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Then, I gave them to Candace, and she went into full chef mode, coming up with all sorts of new things...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Like... "Romaritime Flower Meat Jerky Mixed Rice." At first glance, it looks no different than the usual Aaru Mixed Rice...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: But then it hits your tongue, and... You get that delicious meat, the hearty rice, and this super refreshing aftertaste. All without being greasy!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: It's a great way to refuel, and it's not too dry. Honestly, perfect for camping out in the desert.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: I'm not against improving traditional cuisine... within the bounds of reason, of course.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: After all, every ingredient is precious out in the desert. Nothing must go to waste.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Why didn't you accept that outfit from me, then? Fabrics are a valuable resource too.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: I mean, I know I'm pretty casual, and not the most "fashionable," I guess... But I had someone help me pick it out. I'm sure nothing was wrong with the fit.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: In the end, it went to the girl in our merc band who does the accounting. She seemed to appreciate it, at least.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: I did appreciate it, Dehya. It was extremely thoughtful.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: But as the Guardian of Aaru Village, my goal is to blend in, not stand out. Besides, fine clothes should go to people who have an occasion to wear them.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: If your accountant is to represent the Blazing Beasts in business settings, she should have something to wear. That's why I recommended the clothes go to her.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Oh! Why didn't you say so earlier? I thought you just didn't like what I picked out!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Well, seeing as the Blazing Beasts will be holing up in Aaru Village for the foreseeable future, if you still want to offer something as thanks...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: You could bring us some bolts of cloth. I'm somewhat familiar with tailoring, and I could use them to fashion sand and dust-resistant cloaks for everyone.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: The fabric doesn't need to be expensive, just resistant to wear and tear. I trust your judgment on that.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Don't worry. I'll think carefully about the shape and pattern when I make one for you.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Then all will know that you are an esteemed guest of our village.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ooh, so I'm getting one too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks! No need to make it too complicated!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Oh man, I'm getting kind of excited, ha...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: In that case, maybe I'll head to Liyue next. I've heard you can get some really nice fabric there without breaking the bank...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Oh, and they've got a huge selection of silks as well, if that's what we're going for.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: But, they've also got security in spades, so no merc work for us. We'll just be tourists — polite, well-behaved travelers.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Once we're done here, I'll make a plan with the rest of the Beasts.

choices.text: A cloak is perfect for this environment...
Give me a bit, I'll be right back.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: No worries! We'll start once you're in peak form!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Feel free to get some rest if you need it. We have more than enough time.
